name: Farte
source: Faltefierte is an elf girl who lived in the woods, scaring the intruders and waiting for return of her brother, who disappeared many years ago. For some unknown reason, the elven race did not participate in a large-scale war for survival against the demons that took place a century ago. Moreover, the elves had completely disappeared. And every person who saw Falte, wasn't only surprised to meet her, but also didn't missed a chance to accuse her and all the elven race of cowardice. Although Falte painfully experienced such treatment, it didn't stop her to bravely challenge the powerful forces of evil and overcome many difficult trials. But despite her great age, she looks and acts like a clumsy and sulky child. In addition, she is constantly in fight with Lyrica, arguing about the age and size of the breast.
